## Checklist

- [ ] Tested: `swift test` in `mac-app/` and/or `./gradlew :core:test assembleDebug` in `android-app/`
- [ ] Tried on real devices, or explained below why that wasn't needed
- [ ] Protocol change? `SPEC.md` and `spec/vectors.json` are updated, and both apps' vector tests pass (or N/A)
- [ ] User-facing text in English and Traditional Chinese (or noted that a translation is needed)
- [ ] No pairing links, keys, real device names, personal files, or new network-contacting SDKs in code, tests, logs or screenshots
